# Licence text sources

Some bundled npm packages (including `@excalidraw/excalidraw` itself) ship no licence file, so these texts were copied from upstream:

| File | Source |
| --- | --- |
| `excalidraw-MIT.txt` | https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/blob/v0.18.0/LICENSE |
| `Virgil-OFL.md` | https://github.com/excalidraw/virgil/blob/main/LICENSE.md |
| `Excalifont-NOTICE.txt` | https://plus.excalidraw.com/excalifont (OFL-1.1) and the font's naming table |
| `CascadiaCode-OFL.txt` | https://github.com/microsoft/cascadia-code/blob/main/LICENSE |
| `ComicShanns-MIT.txt` | https://github.com/shannpersand/comic-shanns/blob/master/LICENSE |
| `LilitaOne-OFL.txt` | https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/lilitaone/OFL.txt |
| `Assistant-OFL.txt` | https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/assistant/OFL.txt |
| `Nunito-OFL.txt` | https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/nunito/OFL.txt |
| `radix-ui-primitives-MIT.txt` | https://github.com/radix-ui/primitives/blob/main/LICENSE (all `@radix-ui/*` packages) |
| `fuzzy-MIT.txt` | https://github.com/mattyork/fuzzy/blob/master/LICENSE-MIT |
| `react-remove-scroll-bar-MIT.txt` | https://github.com/theKashey/react-remove-scroll-bar/blob/master/LICENSE |
